notes: 14 figures in one pass. Drawn wherever an AQA paper prints one: every named shape (triangle/trapezium/rectangle), every speed-time scene, every trapezium-rule region, and both tangent-on-curve gradient problems where the curve equation is given (y=x^2, y=x^3). Skipped figures on the pure read-off/interpretation MC items and the generic 'a curve' gradient items where no equation is stated. All labels cross-checked against problem text; all tangent points and plotted curve points recomputed to satisfy their equations. Theme-safe: text/strokes currentColor, region fills soft colours at fill-opacity 0.3, no external refs.
